name: Gotify
description: A push-notification server with a web interface and mobile apps. Applications post messages with a token; people receive them on their phone.

access.note: Gotify creates exactly one account the first time it starts on an empty database: the admin user named here, with the generated password. Sign in with those at the address, then change the password inside Gotify — this value only seeds the very first account, so a later redeploy that rotates it will not reset the account you already have.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The web interface and message API

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: Messages, applications and the SQLite database

update.notes: Gotify migrates its database on start.

secrets.name: admin-password
secrets.label: Admin password
secrets.description: Only used to create the first user; change it inside Gotify afterwards.
